claims.text: This is a service repository with one deployable service and 30 routes, consumers, or scheduled jobs.
The codebase consists of 43 Python source files and 52 TypeScript source files, along with 5 CSS files and 1 HTML file.
Build and deployment are configured via Dockerfile, package.json, pyproject.toml, render.yaml, and web/package.json.
Continuous integration uses a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml.
The repository runs a service named market-lab as a Render web service from a Dockerfile.
The service executes a command that creates a /data directory and starts marketlab serve on host 0.0.0.0 with a configurable port.
The service reads the PORT setting from the environment.
PostgreSQL is available as a database option through the psycopg dependency.
SQLite is available as a database option through the sqlite3 import.
The service serves static web assets from the web/dist directory.
The service is configured to run behind a proxy.
18 of 30 traced routes pass through src/marketlab/api then src/marketlab.

POST /api/worlds is handled by start_world in src/marketlab/api/app.py which calls world_json, which calls PracticeWorld.statement, PracticeWorld.positions, PracticeWorld.today and instrument_json in src/marketlab/world.py.
POST /api/runs is handled by start_run in src/marketlab/api/app.py which calls summary, which calls instrument_json.
The service exposes 30 HTTP routes defined in src/marketlab/api/app.py and src/marketlab/cluster.py.

Routes are grouped under /api/auth for authentication, /api/runs for run management, /api/sessions for session operations, /api/worlds for world management, and /api/accounts and /api/config for other resources.
Two WebSocket routes are available: /ws/runs/{run_id} in app.py and a catch-all /ws/{rest:path} in cluster.py.
A catch-all HTTP route handling GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS on /{path:path} is defined in cluster.py.
Seven CLI commands are registered via argparse in src/marketlab/cli.py: run, show, serve, cluster, costs, and replay, plus a package-level marketlab command.
Three standalone program entry points exist as scripts: benchmarks/bench_exchange.py, tools/loadtest.py, and tools/serve_for_loadtest.py.
The web frontend provides three npm package scripts in web/package.json: dev (vite), build (tsc --noEmit && vite build), and test (vitest run).
The repository contains 43 Python source files totalling 7,213 lines, 52 TypeScript source files totalling 5,447 lines, 5 CSS files totalling 680 lines, and 1 HTML file of 17 lines.
In the web frontend, code in web/src/components depends on web/src/lib with 82 references.
Code in web/src depends on web/src/components with 9 references and on web/src/lib with 7 references.

In the Python backend, src/marketlab depends on src/marketlab/core with 8 references, on src/marketlab/sim with 5 references, on src/marketlab/ledger with 3 references, and on src/marketlab/api with 1 reference.
The src/marketlab/api module depends on src/marketlab with 6 references and on src/marketlab/core with 1 reference.
The src/marketlab/ledger module depends on src/marketlab with 3 references and on src/marketlab/core with 2 references.
The src/marketlab/sim module depends on src/marketlab with 3 references and on src/marketlab/core with 2 references.
The tools directory depends on src/marketlab with 2 references, and benchmarks depends on src/marketlab/core with 1 reference.
There are mutual dependencies between src/marketlab and each of src/marketlab/api, src/marketlab/ledger, and src/marketlab/sim.

The most depended-upon files are src/marketlab/core/__init__.py used by 42 files, web/src/lib/format.ts used by 25 files, web/src/lib/market.ts used by 24 files, src/marketlab/ledger/__init__.py used by 19 files, and tests/helpers.py used by 17 files.

Run linting with `ruff check .`.
Run type checking with `mypy`.
Run tests with `pytest`.
For the web frontend, run `npm ci` then `npm test` and `npm run build` as CI does.
Frontend development uses `npm run dev` (vite) and `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit && vite build).
Frontend tests run via `npm run test` (vitest run).
